title: fix: regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml for hotcrm/packages/ai
body:
The `hotcrm` submodule added a new `@hotcrm/ai` package whose dependencies were not reflected in the lockfile, causing `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` on every CI build.

- **Lockfile update**: Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to include the 5 missing specifiers from `examples/hotcrm/packages/ai/package.json`: `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`, `axios`, `zod`, `typescript`
